# Insight Recovery Network

> Private addiction and mental health support service based in Newquay, Cornwall, UK, founded and led by Craig Bilton (Founder & Clinical Director, 20+ years of international addiction treatment experience). Delivered online only — telephone, video call, and the Insight OS digital recovery platform — supporting clients across the UK and internationally.

Insight Recovery Network (IRN) helps individuals and families navigating alcohol addiction, drug addiction, mental health difficulties, and co-occurring (dual diagnosis) conditions. IRN is a private support and treatment guidance service, not a regulated healthcare provider; it does not provide clinical diagnoses, prescriptions, or emergency crisis support.

## Services

- [Treatment Placement](https://www.insightrecoverynetwork.com/treatment-placement): Independent, confidential guidance for finding the right private detox or residential rehab facility — UK and international (Thailand, Spain, South Africa, Sri Lanka). Needs assessment, facility shortlisting, admission coordination, and aftercare planning.
- [Online Recovery Programme](https://www.insightrecoverynetwork.com/online-programme): Structured online addiction recovery — weekly group therapy, one-to-one clinical sessions, daily accountability, and relapse prevention planning. An alternative to residential rehab where clinically appropriate.
- [Insight OS](https://www.insightrecoverynetwork.com/insight-os): A digital recovery platform ("the operating system for your recovery") with daily check-ins, mood tracking, guided journaling, relapse prevention tools, recovery planning, and the Anchor recovery guidance system. App: https://irnonline.app
- [Family & Intervention Guidance](https://www.insightrecoverynetwork.com/what-we-offer): Structured support for families navigating a loved one's addiction and the process of seeking appropriate care.
- [Free Self-Assessments](https://www.insightrecoverynetwork.com/assessments): Confidential assessments (7–15 min, no registration) for alcohol use, alcohol detox suitability, drug use, detox suitability, anxiety, depression, and ADHD/impulsivity. Informational, not diagnostic.

## Who It Is For

People concerned about their own alcohol or drug use; people seeking private rehab or detox placement in the UK or abroad; people who need structured recovery support without residential treatment; families seeking guidance or intervention support for a loved one; professionals (EAPs, HR, legal) needing a discreet clinical response to substance or mental health issues.

## Important

If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call 999 (UK) or attend your nearest A&E. These services do not replace emergency or medical care.
